It accepts structured inputs from the prediction-engine-agent, applying compliance rules and brand positioning constraints to generate drafts. Its state space is restricted to draft-only operations, enforced by CI checks and explicit write prohibitions in core application paths. This architecture prevents autonomous publishing while enabling scalable content generation under strict governance.
